description: Eval dataset for the agent-factory (factory-conductor) master orchestration skill: intent parsing, workspace resolution, the 6-stage DAG execution loop with circuit breaker, and the pre-write quality gate.

evals.description: Happy path: /factory create runs the full 6-stage pipeline and every stage PASSes on attempt:0, producing SUCCESS.
assertions: stage_trace has exactly 6 entries, one per universal pipeline stage in order, including a final compile_persist entry
the compile_persist entry has archetype == null and secondary_archetype == null

evals.description: Invalid input: /factory create is missing the mandatory --source flag, halting at Intent Parsing before any dispatch.
assertions: no task_id was minted (Step 3 never reached)

evals.description: Invalid input: an unrecognized verb ('deploy') fails the command enum check at Intent Parsing step 1.3.
assertions: the command field is rejected by the enum constraint before Workspace Resolution runs

evals.description: Boundary case: /factory skill references a --source path that does not exist on disk, failing Workspace Resolution step 2.3 even though Intent Parsing (step 1) passed.
assertions: failure occurs at Workspace Resolution (step 2.3), not Intent Parsing (step 1.3), since all required fields were present and well-typed

evals.description: Boundary case: Stage 1 (Sanitize & Ground, archetype:censor, default tier flash) FAILs on attempt:0 and must auto-escalate to pro on attempt:1 per the Escalation on Failure rule, then PASS, yielding overall SUCCESS.
assertions: stage_trace contains two entries for the sanitize_ground stage: attempt 0 (model_used starts as flash tier, verdict FAIL, pro_validated false since flash is tag-exempt) and attempt 1 (model_used escalated to pro, verdict PASS, pro_validated true)

evals.description: Edge case: Stage 5 (Adversarial Audit, archetype:critic) FAILs on attempt:0, attempt:1, and attempt:2, tripping the circuit breaker and halting the pipeline with BLOCKED before Stage 6 ever runs.
assertions: stage_trace shows exactly 3 dispatch attempts (0, 1, 2) for adversarial_audit, all verdict FAIL
no compile_persist stage entry exists in stage_trace
output_paths is empty (no file was written)

evals.description: Edge case: a subagent classified as ambiguous between specifier (primary) and critic (secondary) is dispatched with both archetype fields populated in its stage_trace entry, per the primary/secondary classification heuristic, and the pipeline still completes with SUCCESS.
assertions: the ambiguously-classified stage's stage_trace entry has archetype == 'specifier' (primary) and secondary_archetype == 'critic' (secondary), matching references/archetypes.md's classification heuristic worked example
the corresponding Blackboard handoff record carries both archetype:specifier and archetype:critic tags per references/blackboard.md
model tier and reasoning depth for that dispatch follow the primary archetype (specifier) only

evals.description: Happy path: /factory review --mode executability with an explicit --model pro override applies the override tier to every stage instead of the archetype defaults, and completes with SUCCESS.
assertions: every non-compile_persist stage_trace entry has model_used == 'pro', overriding the Model Selection Matrix defaults
every non-compile_persist stage_trace entry has pro_validated == true, since all stages ran at pro and were validated for <scratchpad>/<decision_log>/<handoff_payload> tag compliance

evals.description: Boundary case: every stage PASSes including Stage 5 (Adversarial Audit), but the Step 7.1 file write itself fails (e.g. target_dir became unwritable after Step 2.2's earlier check), producing a non-retrying BLOCKED distinct from a circuit-breaker BLOCKED.
assertions: blocker.attempts_exhausted == false, distinguishing this from the circuit-breaker BLOCKED case in EVAL-AF-006 where attempts_exhausted == true
every stage_trace entry for stages sanitize_ground through adversarial_audit has verdict == 'PASS'
no compile_persist entry with verdict PASS exists in stage_trace, since the write failed before that entry would be appended
